data.name: Haydari
data.gender_notes: Haydari is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haydari is an Islamic name which originates from Arabic. It is derived from the word 'haydar' which means 'lion'. Haydari is a title given to someone who is the guide or leader of a party or group. The name Haydari carries the meaning “Guide of the party” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Haydari usually hope their child will grow to embody guide of the party and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Haydari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide of the party.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haydari total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
